lines.text: The night he didn't come home.
lines.show: The night he didn't come home.

lines.text: [softer, a spark of curiosity] A mechanical watch doesn't stop by itself. [low, certain] Someone has to stop winding it.
[after a long pause, very quietly] Eleven-eleven. Three years ago. The night he didn't come home.
lines.show: 11:11. Three years ago. The night he didn't come home.

lines.text: [quiet, a little shaken] He said it like it was the easiest thing in the world.
